raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted and fabricated the release year for Ghar Ki Rani, asserting a “canonical” 2007 date based on IMDb Release Info without evidence, while ignoring authoritative sources indicating 1940 (and an IMDb entry showing 1945). This improper disambiguation and reliance on an invented criterion led to the incorrect conclusion that Heaven Help Us (1985) was released earlier, when Ghar Ki Rani predates it.
